headline: Argus Research Maintains Buy on Charles Schwab, Raises Price Target to $114

summary: Charles Schwab (NYSE:SCHW) has outperformed the market over the past 15 years by 1.4% on an annualized basis producing an average annual return of 13.71%. Currently, Charles Schwab has a market capitalization of $175.64
